scope: CPU dependency-contract validation only; not training, quality, or GPU benchmark evidence

initial_validation_mistake.description: A tiny Qwen model was placed on CPU, but PEFT inferred CUDA while loading its adapter. All final tensors were CPU, while torch.cuda.is_initialized() became true. The assertion caught this; the process exited with code 1 and released its context.
initial_validation_mistake.window_basis: Source CreationTimeUtc was 02:56:35; explicit clock reading after the failed process and initial report was 02:57:00. These are conservative bounds, not exact CUDA allocation timestamps.
initial_validation_mistake.measurement_handling: Parent informed immediately; any overlapping GPU measurements require contamination annotation and rerun. No historical model, quality output, or adapter file was modified.

corrected_validation.change: Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to an empty string before importing Torch or PEFT.

actual_export_header_check.method: Read safetensors header in Windows core environment without Torch installed; no model or CUDA context was loaded.

final_precision_tests.method: Core Windows environment; Torch/PEFT loader tests use explicit test doubles and do not create CUDA contexts.
